name: narrow-processor-and-chain-capability-model
title: Narrow the processor and chain capability model
description: 1.0 gate 5 of 9. Audit P2-1 and P2-2: StreamingProcessor::set_enabled promises transparent bypass that volume and resampler silently ignore, DspChain::add accepts processors its fixed in-place topology cannot drive, DspChain::new accepts a zero rate, and OutputChainParams requires a source_sample_rate the callback then ignores.
creator: Asaiuta
